title: P1: Selection results must show stock names, PIT entry price, and TDX current price
description:
Expected: Selection Center results display stock code plus stock name, replace the main Trace/?? key-list column with useful result fields, and split price semantics explicitly. For current-date selection, the selection entry/watchlist price is resolved from TDX latest available quote or close at run time with quote timestamp/source. For historical selection, e.g. selecting 2026-05-13, factors and scores must use data available no later than 2026-05-12, and the selection entry/watchlist price must use the PIT cutoff close such as 2026-05-12 close. A separate current_price column may use TDX latest quote for display only and must not be used by watchlist import. Raw component_scores remain available in a secondary audit detail surface.
Actual: SelectionCandidate currently carries symbol/score/rank/target fields/reference_price/component_scores/reason but no explicit stock_name, selection_entry_price, or display-only current_price. The UI renders selected stocks as row.symbol only and renders Trace/?? as Object.keys(row.component_scores).join(", "), which shows repeated audit key names. Current reference_price is loaded from market.kline_daily_raw.close_li and is not a TDX current quote.

trigger_condition.user_requirement: Show stock names; use PIT/run-time selection entry price for watchlist import; show a separate TDX current price that is display-only; remove the meaningless primary Trace key-list column.

price_semantics.current_date_selection_entry_price: TDX latest available quote/close at selection run time, with quote_time/source
price_semantics.historical_selection_entry_price: PIT cutoff close, for example target 2026-05-13 uses 2026-05-12-or-earlier allowed close
price_semantics.current_price: TDX latest quote for display only; not used by watchlist import
price_semantics.reference_price: existing artifact/runtime field; must not be silently repurposed as TDX current quote

reproduce_command: Open /paper-v2/selection, run or load a Selection Center run, inspect the selection results table: the stock column shows only the symbol and the Trace/?? column shows comma-separated component_scores keys that are nearly identical across rows instead of useful market fields such as stock name, volume, and previous close.
required_verification: Selection result rows display stock code plus stock name consistently with Paper v2 simulation/trading display-only resolver priority.
Current-date selection records a TDX-sourced selection_entry_price/watchlist_entry_price with quote timestamp/source and does not fabricate prices when TDX is unavailable.

Historical selection records PIT cutoff close as selection_entry_price/watchlist_entry_price; for example target 2026-05-13 uses 2026-05-12-or-earlier allowed close, not 2026-05-13 future data or current TDX quote.
Selection results include a separate current_price/current_quote field from TDX latest quote for display only.
Add-to-watchlist uses selection_entry_price/watchlist_entry_price and never uses display-only current_price.
Raw component_scores remain accessible in a secondary detail surface; the primary table no longer renders comma-separated trace key names by default.
No rank, score, HMM, ST PIT, industry filter, StrategyPackage, or Paper v2 execution behavior changes because of display/price enrichment.

Validation record includes DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 item-by-item matrix and reports production_ddl_gate, production_frontend_dependency_gate, production_backend_dependency_gate, and whether production 8001/3000 were touched.
closure_requirements: Selection Center result UI shows stock code plus name consistently with Paper v2 simulation/trading views.
Selection entry/watchlist price and display-only current TDX price are distinct fields with explicit source/time semantics.
Historical selection price respects PIT cutoff rules; current-date selection can use TDX run-time quote/close.
Watchlist import uses the selection entry price, not the display-only current price.
component_scores/audit trace is preserved outside the primary table, and no selection/trading decision behavior is changed by display enrichment.
non_goals: Do not change selection scoring, ranking, HMM, ST PIT, StrategyPackage manifest, or Paper v2 order execution.
Do not make TDX a factor-computation data source.
Do not use display-only current TDX price as watchlist entry price or historical selection entry price.

events.note: User reported Selection Center result UI gap: stock names missing while Paper v2 simulation displays them, and Trace/?? column is low-value repetitive component_scores key metadata.
Validation MCP create timed out after partially advancing allocator in root; created GitHub issue #183 via gh CLI and mirrored fields into BUG-113 JSON before commit.
Updated BUG-113 scope per user clarification: split PIT selection entry price, watchlist entry price, and display-only TDX current price; keep TDX out of factor computation.
